model.name: diffEditor.repoAwareHistoryFillParity
model.description: On a repo change - manual selector switch OR ?repo URL preselect - the file-history (.de-history) fills identically via RbDiffEditor.populateHistory (git log --follow, no promote/auto-load), so the URL path fires the SAME downstream update as the manual path (AC-behavior-identical). BUILT v0.7.63. populateLeftHistory 751934c1 kept INTACT for its working-file promote/auto-load; populateHistory is the focused deep-link-parity extraction.
